actions.script:
import java.time.LocalDate def tenant = ec.entity.find("zenith.erp.saas.SaasTenant").condition("tenantId", tenantId).disableAuthz().one() if (tenant == null) return def today = java.sql.Date.valueOf(LocalDate.now()) def _prefix = 'SAAS-' + LocalDate.now().toString().substring(0,7).replace('-','') + '-' def _lastInv = ec.entity.find("zenith.erp.saas.SaasInvoice") .condition("invoiceNumber", "like", _prefix + '%').orderBy("-invoiceNumber").disableAuthz().list() int _nextSeq = 1 if (_lastInv) { try { _nextSeq = (_lastInv[0].invoiceNumber.toString().substring(_prefix.length()) as Integer) + 1 } catch (Exception _ne) { _nextSeq = _lastInv.size() + 1 } } def invoiceNumber = _prefix + String.format('%04d', _nextSeq)
def taxOut = ec.service.sync().name("zenith.subscriptions.SubscriptionServices.calculate#SubscriptionTax") .parameter("organizationPartyId", "ZETAERP").parameter("customerPartyId", tenant.organizationPartyId) .parameter("taxableAmount", amount).parameter("gstRate", 18).disableAuthz().call() def _taxAmount = taxOut?.taxAmount ?: 0 def _totalAmount = taxOut?.totalAmount ?: amount
def invResult = ec.service.sync().name("create#zenith.erp.saas.SaasInvoice") .parameter("tenantId", tenantId).parameter("invoiceNumber", invoiceNumber) .parameter("invoiceDate", today).parameter("dueDate", java.sql.Date.valueOf(LocalDate.now().plusDays(7))) .parameter("periodFrom", today).parameter("periodTo", today) .parameter("subtotal", amount).parameter("taxAmount", _taxAmount) .parameter("cgstAmount", taxOut?.cgstAmount).parameter("sgstAmount", taxOut?.sgstAmount) .parameter("igstAmount", taxOut?.igstAmount).parameter("placeOfSupply", taxOut?.placeOfSupply) .parameter("totalAmount", _totalAmount).parameter("currencyUomId", tenant.currencyUomId ?: 'INR') .parameter("statusId", "SiSent").parameter("notes", description ?: 'Prorated plan-change charge') .disableAuthz().call() context.saasInvoiceId = invResult.saasInvoiceId
ec.service.sync().name("create#zenith.erp.saas.SaasAuditLog") .parameter("tenantId", tenantId).parameter("eventType", "PRORATION_INVOICE") .parameter("eventDate", ec.user.nowTimestamp) .parameter("description", (description ?: 'Proration') + ': ' + _totalAmount + ' (subtotal ' + amount + ' + GST ' + _taxAmount + '), invoice ' + invoiceNumber) .disableAuthz().call()
